Your car races another car, and the winner is random. You cannot plan to win. The ride was also very expensive to build. It is the most expensive attraction at Disneyland Resort and one of the most expensive in the world. Before you join the line, check the height sign at the entrance or in the app. Hana stands next to it to make sure.
